newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan consumption still on weak trend -- govt agency.
newsitem.headline: Japan consumption still on weak trend -- govt agency.

text.p: Consumption in Japan remains on a weak trend as household spending for July declined 4.4 percent from a year earlier, the biggest drop since February 1981, an official at the government's Management and Coordination Agency told a news briefing on Tuesday.

The 4.4 percent decline in real household spending for July resulted from temporary factors as well as the effects of a killer food poisoning epidemic that swept the nation this summer, the official said.
"We think consumption is showing a weak trend," he said.

The 4.4 percent drop was the largest since February 1981, when household spending fell a real 4.5 percent year-on-year, the official said. The drop was even larger than one shown in January 1994, when household spending declined 4.2 percent because of the major earthquake in Kobe.
